main:
FOR ORGANISERS
Plan and present your race

From choosing a date to keeping race information useful for runners—all in three clear steps.

Check 2027 dates
ORGANISER WORKFLOW
Plan, present, monitor
1
Check the date
Compare what STK currently knows about 2027 dates.
2
Publish or update a race
Add a race or correct its public information.
3
Promotion and statistics
See which organiser tools are in development.
Keep your race information up to date

Find the existing race page first, or send STK a proposal for a new race or a correction.

Find your race
Add or correct a race
AVAILABLE NOW
Confirm your race information

Find your race and choose “Confirm race information” on its race page. After confirming your email address, you will receive a free basic overview of interest in your race on STK over the last 30 days.
